question: Which additional classes of celestial beings are included in this revealed domain, O beloved?
premises: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas are named.
These are classes of celestial or semi-divine beings.
They extend the scope of the revealed domain.
inference: The revealed domain also includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas.
plain_english: O beloved, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas.
